newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume rises, prices mixed.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume rises, prices mixed.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange increased slightly to 1,462 kilos from 1,400 kilos on Friday as demand rose at the beginning of the week, dealers said.

In dollars per ounce terms gold closed lower at $341.50 from $343.50 on Friday, following weakness in world markets, but in lira terms it rose to 1,489,000 per gram from 1,484,500 due to lira weakness versus the dollar.
The lira brushed a low of 135,310 against the dollar at midday but closed at 135,200 after the central bank bought lira in the afternoon, still below Friday's 134,000 close.
Brokers said trading was lively after weekend gold jewellery sales, but uncertainties over the trend in world markets prevented volume from rising further.
Of the day's trade, 1,267 kilos was done in the morning session with 195 kilos traded in the afternoon. 56 percent of the trade was in lira terms. --Istanbul newsroom +90-212-2750875.
